snippet.title: ADRENALINE RUSH: SAGE '26 Trailer
snippet.description:
Y'know, it's about time my game had a completely new pre-demo to play. This whole thing is a year's worth of effort by me, alongside havin' nearly full Spanish translation, courtesy of @HuistiWolf.

Code re-writes, animation fixes, visual & music improvements, and ACTUAL Sonic-like level design. What a concept. 

Hope you enjoy what I have to offer here, and I hope you enjoy enough to stick around for more in the foreseeable future.

The game: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/adrenaline-rush-sage-26-pre-demo.2923/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/pmtGwgdVrp
Play the prototype: https://kappa-nerd.itch.io/the-boy-and-his-story-prototype

Check out these nerds:

EkuriMoon - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJ-tVyRmKu1MyQ6FKnh1akA
Huisti - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9tOXeeE8wiOKF7GHFIOMCg
Crystal Dreemurr - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRwVHKdB3JqON-2bpXEBipQ
Oofer Princess - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCamPs90yIB0XHihgTwmZ9Pg
Protein Plus + - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCw0R_E_zvs87n_WS59v93Aw

COPPA still sucks.
Get yourself a cookie cat.

#indiegame #indie #solodev #sage2026
